blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Cross-domain few-shot segmentation adapts natural-image pretrained encoders to medical or industrial domains from a few pixel-annotated support masks. Within frozen DINOv3, intermediate per-head attention messages already carry target-background distinctions that baseline final-layer similarities and predictions do not consistently reflect. We propose the State-Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA) to learn how per-head messages should update each receiving token representation while keeping pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen. Inserted right after per-head aggregation, SMIA conditions the transformation of each head's aggregated output (message) on each patch's pre-attention feature (state), allowing similar contextual messages to produce distinct or opposing updates depending on the receiving position. Because scarce support masks cover only limited state-message combinations, a shared low-rank bilinear map confines the learned interactions to low-dimensional state, message, and output subspaces. Added before each adapted block's frozen FFN, these updates yield adapted features that are refined by frozen FFNs and deeper blocks for linear readout. With only 0.51M trainable parameters and single-pass, support-free inference, SMIA achieves six-dataset mean mIoUs of 77.40% at 5 shots and 80.99% at 10 shots across 20 medical and industrial tasks, surpassing the strongest prior methods by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points. In controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone, SMIA also outperforms parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX with a better precision-recall balance.
blocks.zh: 跨域多发分片会从几个像素附加说明的辅助口罩中将自然图像预导编码器适应医学或工业领域. 在被冻结的DINOv3范围内,中间式的每头注意信息已经带有目标背景的区别,而基准最终层的相似性和预测并不连贯地反映出来. 我们建议国家-Message互动适应器(SMIA)学习如何更新每条收到的信号,同时保持预先训练的注意力和FFN参数被冻结。 SMIA将每个头部的集合输出(消息)在每一个补丁的预留功能(状态)上进行变换作为条件,允许类似的上下文消息根据接收位置的不同产生有区别的或对立的更新. 由于稀缺的支持口罩只覆盖有限的状态信息组合,共享的低等双线地图将所学到的相互作用限制在低维状态,消息和输出子空间. 在每个被调整的块被冷冻的FFN之前被添加,这些更新生成了被冷冻的FFN和更深的块所精炼的被修改的特性,用于线性读取. SMIA只有0.51M可训练参数和单行道,无支持推论,在20个医疗和工业任务中,SMIA在6个数据集中实现了平均mIoUs的77.40%,在10个镜头中实现了80.99%,以+3.61和+3.93个百分点超过了以往最强的方法. 在对相同的DINOv3主干线的三个基准进行控制下10发的比较中,SMIA还以更好的精确召回平衡,超越了参数匹配的AdaptFormer,LORA和ParaX.

blocks.en: Acquiring pixel-level masks is costly in both clinical imaging and industrial inspection. Delineating subtle lesions requires specialist time, while newly introduced manufactured parts rarely come with more than a few defective examples. Cross-domain few-shot segmentation (CD-FSS) addresses this setting by transferring natural-image pretrained encoders to domains such as ultrasound, endoscopy, dermoscopy, radiography, and textured industrial surfaces from only a handful of annotated support masks [ 14 , 16 , 26 ] .
blocks.zh: 获得像素级口罩在临床成像和工业检查中都是昂贵的。 描述微妙的损伤需要专家时间,而新引进的制造部件很少出现几个有缺陷的例子。 超声波、内窥镜、皮肤镜、放射光学和纹理化工业表面仅从少数附加说明的辅助面具[14、16、26]中将自然图像预导编码器转移到超声波、内视、皮肤镜、放射光学和纹理化工业表面,从而解决了这种设置。

blocks.en: A few annotated masks rarely cover enough appearance variation to train a dense encoder from scratch. Self-supervised vision foundation models (VFMs) such as DINOv3 [ 20 ] shift the few-shot burden from representation learning to adapting and reading out pretrained features, providing dense patch embeddings and multi-head context aggregation before target adaptation. Yet medical lesions and fine surface cracks often share intensity, texture, or structural continuity with surrounding healthy tissue or intact material. Features that group patches by object part or material identity need not delineate the target boundaries required downstream, and few-shot adaptation must learn this distinction from support masks covering only limited appearances and contexts.
blocks.zh: 少数附加说明的口罩很少覆盖足够多的外观变异,从零开始训练密集的编码器. DINOv3[20]等自我监督的视觉基础模型(VFMs)将少许镜头负担从表现学习转向适应和读取预先训练过的特性,在目标适应前提供密集的补丁嵌入和多头上下文聚合. 然而,医疗损伤和细细的表面裂缝往往与周围的健康组织或完好无损的材料具有强度、纹理或结构连续性。 按物体部分或物质特征划分的组合补丁的特征不需要划定下游所需的目标界限,很少镜头的适应必须从只覆盖有限的外观和背景的支撑面具中吸取这种区别.

blocks.en: Recent VFM-based segmenters either match frozen features against support exemplars without training ( e.g. , INSID3 [ 8 ] ) or train multi-scale decoders on frozen layer outputs ( e.g. , DINO-AugSeg [ 24 ] ). To examine how intermediate pretrained cues carry over to downstream segmentation, Fig. 1 compares a frozen DINOv3 probe, LoRA [ 10 ] , and our adapter, each paired with a linear readout head fit on the same 10-shot support set. On BUSI ultrasound, a single frozen Block-9 head already separates the lesion from surrounding stroma, yet both baselines produce diffuse final-layer similarities and miss nearly the entire lesion. On MVTec Capsule, the frozen head responds to both the crack and nearby printed digits; the frozen probe over-segments the surrounding shell, whereas LoRA retains only a small fragment of the crack.
blocks.zh: 最近的基于VFM的分解器或者在不经过培训的情况下与支持实例匹配冷冻特性(例如INSID3[8]),或者在冷冻层输出上培训多级解码器(例如DINO-AugSeg[24]). 为了检查中间预试的提示如何传递到下游的分区,图1比较了冷冻的DINOv3探测器,LORA [10],以及我们的适配器,每对都配有一个线性读出头,适合在同一10发的辅助装置上. 在BUSI超声波上,一个单一的冷冻的Block-9头已经将损伤与周围的stroma区分开来,然而这两个基线都会产生扩散的末层相似性,并错过了几乎整个损伤. 在MVTec Capsule上,冰冻头对裂缝和附近的印刷数字都有反应;冰冻的探测器将周围的外壳隔开,而LORA只保留了一小片裂缝.

blocks.en: These examples show that target-relevant structure in intermediate messages is not consistently reflected in final predictions, motivating adaptation of how intermediate messages contribute to token updates. Within an attention block, a head’s aggregated message summarizes contextual cues pooled for a location, whereas the pre-attention local state carries the receiving patch’s own content and prior context. This distinction matters when adjacent target and background patches receive strongly aligned messages yet differ in their pre-attention states, as illustrated by the boundary pairs in Sec. 4.4 .
blocks.zh: 这些例子表明,中间信息中的目标相关结构在最后预测中没有得到一致的反映,这促使人们调整中间信息如何有助于象征性更新。 在关注区块内,一个头的汇总信息总结了某个地点的上下文提示,而预留的本地状态则带有接收补丁本身的内容和先前的上下文。 当相邻的目标和背景补丁收到强烈的对齐消息,但其前置状态却有所不同时,这种区分关系重大,第4.4节中的边界对表示这一点。

blocks.en: We propose the State–Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA), which keeps pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen and inserts a conditional branch right after per-head aggregation. Whereas LoRA applies token-invariant low-rank increments to selected projections, SMIA parameterizes the added transformation of each head’s message as a linear function of the receiving patch’s local state. Similar contextual messages can therefore yield distinct or opposing updates across positions, directing target supervision toward how pooled contextual cues modify each receiving representation.
blocks.zh: 我们提议使用国家-Message Interactive Refecter(SMIA), 而LORA则对选定的预测采用符号-不变量的低排名递增, SMIA 参数化了每个头条消息的附加变换, 作为接收补丁的局部状态的线性函数. 因此,类似的背景信息可以产生不同立场的明显或相反的更新,将目标监督导向集合背景提示如何改变每个接收代表。

blocks.en: Parameterizing this conditional relation freely in ambient dimensions would require O ⁡ ( d 2 ​ d h ) O(d^{2}d_{h}) weights per head, whereas scarce support masks cover only limited combinations of content and context. SMIA instead restricts the interaction to low-dimensional state, message, and output subspaces through a structured bilinear map shared across patches and images within a task. We add these state-guided updates before each adapted block’s frozen feed-forward network (FFN); frozen FFNs and deeper blocks then refine the updated features for support-free inference with a single linear layer.

blocks.en: Across 20 tasks spanning five medical benchmarks and all 15 MVTec AD categories, SMIA sets a new state of the art at both 5 and 10 shots while maintaining over 82 % 82\% industrial precision alongside substantially higher defect recall ( Sec. 4.2 ). Our main contributions are: • We propose SMIA, an in-block post-aggregation adapter that keeps pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen and conditions per-head message updates on each patch’s local state within shared low-rank subspaces, with 0.51M trainable parameters, O ⁡ ( N p ) O(N_{p}) overhead, and single-pass, support-free inference. • We validate this state-dependent mechanism through forward-pass boundary diagnostics and controlled interventions: SMIA maps strongly aligned boundary messages to opposing updates, and norm-matched counterfactual state swaps under fixed messages flip local foreground–background predictions. • Across 20 medical and industrial tasks, SMIA improves six-dataset mean mIoU over the strongest prior methods by + 3.61 +3.61 and + 3.93 +3.93 percentage points at 5 and 10 shots, ranking first on 16/20 and 18/20 tasks. In controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone, SMIA achieves higher mIoU than frozen readout and parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX, with a better precision–recall balance than the three PEFT baselines.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: CD-FSS transfers natural-image pretrained segmenters to target domains with large distribution shifts using a few support masks [ 14 ] . One line of work redesigns cross-image support–query matching, such as self-disentangling and recomposing multi-layer features in SDRC [ 22 ] . Other methods adapt representations to the target domain: HERA combines layer selection, regularized target tuning, and pixelwise calibration [ 16 ] , while MPA uses multi-view progressive adaptation [ 17 ] . Related industrial methods target small surface defects by suppressing background clutter during matching in SOFS [ 26 ] or adapting SAM hierarchically in DefectSAM [ 25 ] . At test time, however, these approaches still depend on cross-image exemplar matching, prototype calibration, or multi-scale decoders. By contrast, SMIA learns in-block residual updates from the support masks for single-pass, support-free segmentation.
blocks.zh: CD-FSS将自然图像预先训练的配电器转移至使用几个支持口罩进行大范围配电转移的目标域[14]. 一行工作重新设计跨图像支持-query匹配,如SDRC[22]中的自我拆分和重构多层特性. 其他方法根据目标域调整表示: HERA结合了层选择,规范化的目标调谐,以及像素校准[16],而MPA则采用多视图渐进适应[17]. 相关的工业方法针对小的表面缺陷,在SOFS[26]中的匹配过程中压制背景杂乱,或者在DefectSAM[25]中按等级调整SAM. 然而,在测试时,这些方法仍然依赖于跨图像实例匹配,原型校准,或多尺度解码器. 相比之下,SMIA从支持口罩中学习到屏蔽内剩余更新,用于单路口,支持无阻分割.

blocks.en: Self-supervised VFMs such as DINOv3 [ 20 ] provide spatially coherent patch features that markedly improve few-shot segmentation. Training-free matchers infer masks directly from frozen feature geometry: INSID3 combines positional debiasing, intra-query clustering, and exemplar matching [ 8 ] , whereas RSRM re-fuses multi-layer features for region matching [ 21 ] . Supervised decoder methods keep the encoder frozen and train backend readouts; DINO-AugSeg pairs Haar wavelet feature augmentation with a cross-guided U-Net on frozen DINOv3 [ 24 ] , and DistillFSS distills support–query fusion into a standalone network [ 9 ] . In both families, support masks inform prediction only after the frozen encoder finishes token processing. SMIA instead adapts token updates inside each Transformer block right after per-head aggregation, allowing frozen FFNs and deeper blocks to refine task-specific features progressively.
blocks.zh: 自控的VFM如DINOv3[20]提供了空间连贯的补丁特征,显著改进了几发分片. 直接来自冷冻特征几何的无训练匹配器推断口罩:INSID3结合了位置脱边,静电内组装,以及实例匹配[8],而RSRM则重新使用多层特征进行区域匹配[21]. 监督的解码器方法使编码器保持冷冻,并训练后端的读取;DINO-AugSeg配对的Haar波莱特特性增强,在冷冻的DINOv3[24]上采用交叉导引的U-Net,DistillFSS蒸馏支持-query核聚变为独立的网络[9]. 在两个家庭,支持口罩只有在冷冻编码器完成符号处理后才能告知预测. SMIA转而在每头集成后立即调整每个变形器块内的符号更新,允许冷冻的FFN和更深的块逐渐完善特定任务特征.

blocks.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) adapts frozen encoders through compact trainable modules, such as low-rank projection updates in LoRA [ 10 ] or parallel FFN bottlenecks in AdaptFormer [ 6 ] . For dense prediction and domain generalization, Rein couples learnable token banks to patch features [ 23 ] , while ParaX routes shared expert weights at the image level [ 15 ] . Recently, Gated Attention [ 19 ] modulates per-head attention outputs with query-dependent sigmoid gates during language model pretraining. In frozen-backbone adaptation, however, LoRA applies token-invariant low-rank increments to selected projections, and AdaptFormer, Rein, and ParaX adapt block-level token features without conditioning per-head message updates on pre-attention local state. SMIA keeps pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen, using each patch’s local state right after per-head aggregation to weight shared low-rank message matrices for signed directional updates.

blocks.en: 3. State–Message Interaction Adapter
blocks.zh: 3个 状态- 信息互动适应器

blocks.en: SMIA keeps all pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen and adds a lightweight post-aggregation branch inside each adapted Transformer block ( Fig. 2 ). Rather than tuning attention parameters, this branch conditions each head’s residual update on the patch’s pre-attention local state within learned low-rank subspaces. Below we present the state-guided post-aggregation update ( Sec. 3.1 ), its low-rank bilinear parameterization ( Sec. 3.2 ), the resulting state-dependent basis combination ( Sec. 3.3 ), and few-shot training and inference ( Sec. 3.4 ).
blocks.zh: SMIA保持所有预先训练的注意力和FFN参数冻结,并在每个经过改造的变形器块(图2)内增加一个轻量级的后聚合分支. 这个分支不是调整注意力参数,而是在学习到的低级子空间内,给每个头部在预留局部状态上的剩余更新附加条件. 下面我们介绍国家指导的汇总后更新(第3.1节),其低排名的双线参数化(第3.2节),由此产生的国家依赖基础组合(第3.3节),以及少发训练和推论(第3.4节)。

blocks.en: 3.1. State-Guided Post-Aggregation Update
blocks.zh: 3.1. 国家指导的隔离后最新情况

blocks.en: Given a target support set 𝒮 = { ( I n , Y n ) } n = 1 N \mathcal{S}=\{(I_{n},Y_{n})\}_{n=1}^{N} of N N pixel-annotated images, SMIA adapts intermediate patch representations inside the frozen pretrained encoder. Although SMIA can be combined with heavier segmentation decoders, we pair the adapted encoder with a single linear layer trained on 𝒮 \mathcal{S} so representation quality is evaluated directly without extra decoder capacity. blocks.en: During training, foreground patch logits from the linear head are bilinearly upsampled to the input canvas, unpadded, and resized to native image resolution. We minimize a class-balanced pixelwise BCE loss that averages within each present class of an image and weights present classes and sampled supports equally. At test time, the same restored native-resolution logits are thresholded at 0 0 , corresponding to foreground probability p > 0.5 p>0.5 .

blocks.en: 4.1. Experimental Setup and Unified Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.1. 实验设置和统一协议

blocks.en: Our benchmark covers 20 segmentation tasks spanning five medical datasets and all 15 object and texture anomaly categories of MVTec AD [ 3 ] . The medical benchmarks comprise BUSI breast ultrasound lesions [ 1 ] , Kvasir-SEG [ 12 ] and CVC-ClinicDB [ 4 ] colonoscopy polyps, ISIC 2018 Task 1 dermoscopy lesions [ 7 ] , and Chest X-ray dual-lung segmentation pooling Shenzhen and Montgomery radiographs [ 11 , 5 ] . Main 20-task evaluations ( Tabs. 1 and 2 ) test N = 5 N=5 and N = 10 N=10 supports across five random draws, where each 5-shot set is strictly nested inside its 10-shot counterpart. All 20 tasks use image-level splits that treat all non-support images in the task inventory as test queries. Specifically, ISIC pools the official training, validation, and test splits while sampling supports strictly from the training split, and MVTec AD likewise pools all official splits. On BUSI and MVTec AD, which contain target-free normal scans, N = 5 N=5 and N = 10 N=10 enforce positive/negative quotas of 3 / 2 3/2 and 6 / 4 6/4 and count normal all-background masks toward budget N N (Supplementary Sec. A.1).

blocks.zh: 4.2. 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: Table 1 compares SMIA against six recent methods evaluated using their authors’ official implementations under our fixed-support protocol (Supplementary Sec. A.3): training-free VFM matchers INSID3 [ 8 ] and RSRM [ 21 ] , frozen-DINOv3 decoder learner DINO-AugSeg [ 24 ] , hierarchical SAM adapter DefectSAM [ 25 ] , and CD-FSS methods HERA [ 16 ] and MPA [ 17 ] . Per-category MVTec AD scores are reported in Supplementary Tab. S1.

blocks.en: SMIA achieves 77.40% Overall mIoU at N = 5 N=5 and 80.99% at N = 10 N=10 , surpassing the strongest prior baseline at each budget—73.79% for 5-shot HERA and 77.06% for 10-shot DINO-AugSeg—by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points (pp). Notably, ViT-S+/16 is smaller than the ViT-L/16, ViT-B/16, and ConvNeXt-L backbones used by INSID3, HERA, RSRM, and DINO-AugSeg, and SMIA updates only 0.51M parameters, or 1.7% of DINO-AugSeg. These gains hold independently in both domains . Across the five medical datasets, SMIA leads at both 5 shots (78.61% vs. 77.46%) and 10 shots (81.80% vs. 79.60%) with top foreground precision of 85.48% and 85.93% (Supplementary Tab. S2), while widening its lead on MVTec AD to +4.98 and +5.38 pp. At N = 5 N=5 , SMIA also shows low draw-to-draw variance with a 0.28% Overall SD, compared with 0.79%–1.90% for prior methods. It ranks first overall in every draw at both budgets, leads 16/20 and 18/20 tasks at 5 and 10 shots, and already exceeds the best 10-shot baseline mean using just 5 supports (77.40% vs. 77.06%).

blocks.en: Improvements are most pronounced where low-contrast lesions or thin defects resemble surrounding background texture. On medical benchmarks, SMIA gains +3.86 and +3.58 pp on ISIC 2018, improves 10-shot BUSI by +3.72 pp over DINO-AugSeg (70.32% vs. 66.59%), and reaches 94.38% and 94.63% on Chest X-ray. On MVTec AD, it leads 14 of the 15 categories at 10 shots, including margins of +12.31 pp on Screw and +7.25 pp on Grid. Prior baselines lead on only two 10-shot tasks: Kvasir-SEG, where HERA and RSRM reach 83.45% and 83.00% versus 82.21% for SMIA, and MVTec Transistor, where DINO-AugSeg reaches 65.33% versus 63.03%.
blocks.zh: 在低毗连性损伤或细小缺陷与周围背景纹理相似的情况下,改善最为明显。 在医疗基准方面,SMIA在2018年国际标准行业分类上的收益为+3.86和+3.58,比DINO-AugSeg(70.32%对66.59%)改进了10发BUSI,在胸X射线上达到94.38%和94.63%. 在MVTec AD上,它以10个镜头领先15个类别中的14个,包括Screw上的+12.31页的边缘和Grid上的+7.25页. 先前的基线只导致两个10发任务:Kvasir-SEG,HERA和RSRM达到83.45%,SMIA达到83.00 %,对82.21%;MVTec晶体管,DINO-AugSeg达到65.33%,对63.03%.

blocks.en: Existing baselines split into two opposing regimes on MVTec AD ( Tab. 2 ). Support-retrieval matchers INSID3, RSRM, and HERA reach up to 72.74% pixel recall, yet trigger widespread false positives across repetitive normal textures that drive foreground precision below 29%. Conversely, support-free decoders DINO-AugSeg and DefectSAM maintain 73.84%–81.60% precision, but miss subtle defects with only 26.91%–38.68% recall at N = 5 N=5 and 39.83%–50.15% at N = 10 N=10 . SMIA reaches 71.38% and 76.96% industrial mIoU by combining top precision (82.14% and 83.55%) with +9.35 and +11.20 pp higher recall than DINO-AugSeg. At inference time, it runs support-free on a single RTX 5090 in 13.7 ms on CVC-ClinicDB ( 512 2 512^{2} canvas) and 23.5 ms on MVTec Bottle ( 768 2 768^{2} canvas), using 6.7 × \times –8.9 × \times less GPU memory than DINO-AugSeg (Supplementary Tab. S3). Even on 10-shot Transistor, where DINO-AugSeg obtains higher mIoU (65.33% vs. 63.03%), SMIA maintains substantially higher foreground precision (78.22% vs. 60.51%).

SMIA通过将顶精度(82.14%和83.55%)与+9.35和+11.20合并,比DINO-AugSeg更高. 在推论时间,它以13.7 ms在CVC-ClinicDB(512 2 512^{2}帆布)和23.5 ms在MVTec瓶(768 2 768^{2}帆布)上运行,使用6.7×\times–8.9×\times比DINO-AugSeg(补充 Tab. The evaluated PEFT baselines comprise parallel FFN bottlenecks in AdaptFormer [ 6 ] at width b = 55 b=55 , query–value LoRA [ 10 ] at rank r = 28 r=28 and α = 56 \alpha=56 , and post-block multi-scale convolutions with image-routed shared experts in ParaX [ 15 ] at width b = 28 b=28 . blocks.en: The frozen linear probe yields 75.94% mean mIoU, with 70.25% foreground precision and 77.48% recall. Among the evaluated PEFT baselines, AdaptFormer reaches 77.56% mean mIoU, query–value LoRA reaches 78.01%, and ParaX reaches 78.26%. Although all three improve precision to 84.51%–87.03%, they lose 9.45–10.50 pp in recall (dropping to 66.99%–68.03%) and fall below the frozen probe on ISIC 2018 (77.06%–77.66% vs. 77.95%). Keeping pretrained attention parameters frozen, default SMIA ( r = 8 r=8 ) raises precision from 70.25% to 88.77% while retaining higher recall (69.01%) than all three PEFT baselines. 5. Conclusion and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论和讨论

blocks.en: We presented the State–Message Interaction Adapter (SMIA) for cross-domain few-shot segmentation on vision foundation models. Keeping pretrained attention and FFN parameters frozen, SMIA conditions each head’s post-aggregation message update on the receiving patch’s pre-attention state within low-dimensional subspaces, before frozen FFNs and deeper blocks refine the updated features for linear readout. With only 0.51M trainable parameters, SMIA achieves six-dataset mean mIoUs of 77.40% at 5 shots and 80.99% at 10 shots across 20 medical and industrial tasks, exceeding the strongest prior method at each budget by +3.61 and +3.93 percentage points. On one RTX 5090, single-pass, support-free inference takes 13.7 ms (166 MiB) on CVC-ClinicDB and 23.5 ms (220 MiB peak PyTorch-allocated GPU memory) on MVTec Bottle. Controlled 10-shot comparisons across three benchmarks on the same DINOv3 backbone further show higher mIoU and a better precision–recall balance than parameter-matched AdaptFormer, LoRA, and ParaX. Forward boundary comparisons reveal opposing updates for closely aligned messages, and norm-matched state swaps under fixed messages flip local predictions. Together, these results support learning how per-head messages update each receiving representation as a function of local state while keeping pretrained attention parameters frozen.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了国家-Message互动适应器(SMIA), SMIA保持预先紧张的注意力和FFN参数冻结,在冷冻FFN和更深的块完善更新的线性读出功能之前,对每个头部在低维子空间内接收补丁前的注意状态进行更新. SMIA只有0.51M的可训练参数,在20项医疗和工业任务中,SMIA实现了6个数据集的平均mIoUs,在5个镜头中为77.40%,在10个镜头中为80.99%,超过每个预算中最强的先前方法+3.61和+3.93个百分点. 在一个RTX 5090上,单传,无支撑推论在CVC-ClinicDB上需要13.7 ms(166 MiB),在MVTec瓶上需要23.5 ms(220 MiB 峰值PyTorch-aldication GPU内存). 在相同的DINOv3主干线上,对三个基准进行了10发的对照,进一步显示mIoU更高,比参数匹配的AdapitFormer、LORA和ParaX更精确的召回平衡。 前进边界比较显示对紧密对齐消息的对立更新,在固定消息下规范匹配的状态互换会翻转本地预测. 这些结果共同支持学习如何更新每个接收信息作为当地国家的一项功能,同时保持预先训练的注意力参数冻结。

blocks.en: SMIA conditions each head’s update on the receiving patch state without explicit cross-region geometric constraints. While effective on localized lesions and surface defects, on MVTec Transistor its recall remains conservative for missing or displaced leads—where exposed board regions can appear locally intact—despite 78.22% foreground precision. Combining local state-conditioned updates with non-local relational priors to capture global part geometry is a promising direction for future work.
blocks.zh: SMIA为每个头更新接收补丁状态提供了条件,没有明显的跨区域几何限制. 虽然对局部损伤和表面缺陷有效,但MVTec Transistor的召回对于缺失或转移的线索(暴露在其中的板块区域可以呈现出当地完好无损)仍然是保守的,尽管前缘精度为78.22%。 将本地国家有条件的更新与非本地关系前科相结合,以捕捉全球部分几何学,是未来工作的有希望的方向.

During training, paired support augmentations are applied with probability 0.5 0.5 per visit: brightness and contrast scaling in [ 0.9 , 1.1 ] [0.9,1.1] , 3 × 3 3\times 3 Gaussian blur with σ ∈ [ 0.1 , 0.5 ] \sigma\in[0.1,0.5] ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ), hue jitter in [ − 0.01 , 0.01 ] [-0.01,0.01] ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ), and horizontal flips on the five medical tasks ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ). For rotation, orientation-unconstrained top-view industrial parts (Metal Nut, Screw, and Hazelnut) use 90 ∘ / 180 ∘ / 270 ∘ 90^{\circ}/180^{\circ}/270^{\circ} quarter-turns ( p = 0.25 p=0.25 ), while all other tasks use continuous rotations in [ − 5 ∘ , 5 ∘ ] [-5^{\circ},5^{\circ}] . Calibration, head pre-fitting, and test evaluation use unaugmented images.

blocks.en: A.3. External Baseline Configurations
blocks.zh: A.3. 外部基线配置

blocks.en: In Main Paper Tab. 1 and Tab. S1 , DINO-AugSeg [ 24 ] , DefectSAM [ 25 ] , and MPA [ 17 ] train on all N N support image–mask pairs per draw, including normal all-background masks. HERA [ 16 ] fits once per draw over M M positive supports for M − 1 M-1 Adam steps using held-out and subset cross-entropy regularization—enumerating small support subsets or sampling six subsets when combinations grow large—and reuses the adapted model across all queries. Training-free matchers INSID3 [ 8 ] and RSRM [ 21 ] match query features directly against positive supports at test time.
blocks.zh: 在Main Paper Tab. 1和Tab. S1中,DINO-AugSeg [24],DefectSAM [25],和MPA [17] 列车在所有N支持图像上——每幅图画的面具配对,包括普通的全背面面具. HERA [16] 适合M正支持M − 1 M-1 Adam 步骤,采用牵引和子集的跨内向正规化——假设小支持子集或当组合增长大时对六个子集进行取样——并在所有查询中重新使用经过调整的模型。 无训练匹配器 INSID3 [8]和RSRM [21] 在测试时直接与正支持匹配查询功能.

blocks.en: Each baseline retains its official architecture, input resolution, and optimizer schedule under our fixed-support splits. INSID3, RSRM, and HERA run at 1024 2 1024^{2} , 480 2 480^{2} , and 400 2 400^{2} inputs, respectively. DefectSAM fine-tunes SAM-B for 150 AdamW epochs ( lr = 2 × 10 − 4 \mathrm{lr}=2\times 10^{-4} ) on long-edge-padded 1024 2 1024^{2} inputs. MPA uses its source-free ImageNet ResNet-50 release ( lr = 5 × 10 − 4 \mathrm{lr}=5\times 10^{-4} , refinement enabled) at 400 2 400^{2} for its default 40 outer epochs on one fixed-support episode per draw ( 3 3 steps in stages 1–5 and 25 25 in stage 6; 40 SGD updates without query stagnation checks) and supplies the support set at query time. DINO-AugSeg trains with Adam ( lr = 10 − 4 \mathrm{lr}=10^{-4} ) for 250 epochs at 224 2 224^{2} on ISIC 2018 and 1,000 epochs at 512 2 512^{2} elsewhere ( 30,332,418 30{,}332{,}418 trainable parameters), evaluating final-epoch weights. At inference, RSRM, DINO-AugSeg, HERA, and MPA apply their official two-class argmax followed by nearest-neighbor resize to native resolution, while INSID3 and DefectSAM produce native-size binary masks directly.
blocks.zh: 每个基线都保留其官方架构,输入分辨率,并在我们的固定支持分割下优化时间表. INSID3,RSRM,和HERA分别运行于1024 2 1024^{2},480 2 480^{2}和400 2 400^{2}输入. DefectSAM微调SAM-B为150 AdamW epocts(lr = 2 × 10 − 4\mathrm{lr}=2\times 10^{-4}),用于长尖加法1024 2 1024^{2}输入. MPA使用它的无源图像Net ResNet-50发布(lr = 5× 10− 4\mathrm{lr}=5\times 10^{-4}, 精细化),在400 2 400^{2}默认的40个外部历程在每集一个固定支持插曲上(第1~5阶段3步,第6阶段25步25步;40 SGD更新没有查询停滞检查),并在查询时提供支持集. DINO-AugSeg列车配属亚当(lr = 10 – 4\mathrm{lr}=10^{-4}),为224 224^{2}在2018年国际标准工业分类上为250个纪元,在512 2 512^{2}其他地方为1000个纪元(30,332,418 30{,}332{,}418 个可列车参数),评价最终纪元重量. 在推论中,RSRM,DINO-AugSeg,HERA,和MPA应用了它们的官方双级对称码,之后近邻的大小调整为本地分辨率,而INSID3和DefectSAM则直接生产本地大小的二进制口罩.

blocks.en: B.1. Per-Category MVTec AD and Domain Analysis
blocks.zh: B.1. 每类MVTec AD和域分析

blocks.en: Beyond the aggregate scores in Main Paper Tab. 1, grouping the 15 MVTec AD categories in Tab. S1 into five stationary surface textures (carpet, grid, leather, tile, and wood) and ten structured multi-part objects ( e.g. , capsules, cables, screws, and transistors) clarifies two distinct baseline failure modes. Across MVTec AD, anomalous pixels cover only 0.08 % 0.08\% to 3.87 % 3.87\% of image area, falling below 1.0 % 1.0\% in nine categories. On stationary textures, where intact background patterns recur across scans, matchers INSID3, RSRM, and HERA reach 36.60 % 36.60\% – 41.00 % 41.00\% 10-shot precision and 64.31 % 64.31\% – 68.28 % 68.28\% mIoU. On multi-part objects, pose, lighting, and part layout vary across scans, and qualitative comparisons show exemplar-matching responses on intact threads, rims, or markings; the matchers’ 10-shot precision falls to 4.80 % 4.80\% – 24.63 % 24.63\% and mIoU to 44.45 % 44.45\% – 55.29 % 55.29\% . Conversely, support-free decoders DINO-AugSeg and DefectSAM keep 77.76 % 77.76\% – 78.66 % 78.66\% 10-shot object precision, but miss sub-percent defects with only 24.64 % 24.64\% – 34.96 % 34.96\% ( N = 5 N=5 ) and 36.46 % 36.46\% – 45.79 % 45.79\% ( N = 10 N=10 ) object recall.
blocks.zh: 超越了Main Paper Tab. 1中的汇总分数,在Tab中分组了15个MVTec AD类. S1分为5个固定的表面纹理(地毯、网格、皮革、瓷砖和木材)和10个结构化的多部分物体(如胶囊、电缆、螺丝和晶体管),澄清了两种不同的基线故障模式。 通过MVTec AD,反常像素只覆盖了0.08%的0.08\%到3.87%的图像区域,在9个类别中低于1.0%的1.0\%. 在固定纹理上,完整的背景图案在扫描中反复出现,匹配器为INSID3,RSRM,HERA达到36.60% 36.60 — 41.00 — 41.00 — 64.31 % 64.31 — 68.28 % mIoU。 在多部分的物体上,姿势、照明和部分布局各有不同,质量比较显示,在完整线条、环线或标记上进行了模范匹配反应;匹配者的10发精度下降到4.80% – 24.63% 24.63 % 24.63 % 和 mIoU下降到44.45% 44.45 % 55.29 % 。 相反,支持免费解码器DINO-AugSeg和DefectSAM保持77.76 % 77.76 % 78.66 % 78.66 % 78.66 % 10发精度,但漏掉了只有24.64 % 24.64 % 34.96 % 34.96 % ( N= 5 N= 5) 和 36.46 % 45.79 % (N= 10 N= 10 10) 对象召回的次级缺陷。

blocks.en: SMIA achieves the highest mean mIoU in both industrial groups. On surface textures, SMIA reaches 76.64% and 80.52% mIoU, beating the best prior method at each budget by + 5.90 +5.90 and + 5.97 +5.97 pp (5-shot MPA at 70.74 % 70.74\% and 10-shot DINO-AugSeg at 74.55 % 74.55\% ). On multi-part objects, it reaches 68.76% and 75.18% mIoU, surpassing DINO-AugSeg by + 3.80 +3.80 and + 5.08 +5.08 pp while achieving 56.02 % 56.02\% 10-shot object recall (vs. 45.79 % 45.79\% ) and 84.48 % 84.48\% precision. Only on global-layout anomalies in Transistor (Main Paper Sec. 5) does DINO-AugSeg obtain higher 10-shot mIoU ( 65.33 % 65.33\% vs. 63.03 % 63.03\% ), while SMIA maintains higher foreground precision ( 78.22 % 78.22\% vs. 60.51 % 60.51\% ).

blocks.en: To examine why terminal readouts on frozen encoders struggle near subtle boundaries, we inspect token organization at the final LayerNorm of DINOv3 ViT-S+/16. Because self-supervised pretraining encourages cross-view semantic invariance, terminal features tend to group patches by coarse part or material identity rather than anomaly status. On MVTec Cable ( 768 × 768 768\times 768 canvas), we form two cross-image comparison groups across four test scans (Groups 1 and 2); each group pairs a 2 × 2 2\times 2 -patch damaged inner-insulation region on one scan with 2 × 2 2\times 2 -patch intact inner-insulation and outer-sheath cut regions on a separate scan. Damaged inner-insulation patches show higher median final-layer cosine similarity to intact inner insulation than to outer-sheath cuts: 0.707 0.707 versus 0.552 0.552 in Group 1 and 0.668 0.668 versus 0.553 0.553 in Group 2. When adjacent target and background patches remain strongly aligned at the encoder output, a static linear readout fit on scarce supports struggles to separate boundaries consistently across scans. On BUSI ( 32 × 32 32\times 32 patch grid, λ = 10 − 3 \lambda=10^{-3} ridge-regularized balanced BCE probe fit on five supports), a vertically adjacent lesion-margin and stroma pair on one benign query has a final-layer cosine of 0.962 0.962 and straddles the decision boundary ( + 2.848 +2.848 vs. − 1.880 -1.880 ). On a second benign query with different speckle statistics, a comparable boundary pair shares nearly the same feature cosine ( 0.958 0.958 ), with 48.4 % 48.4\% foreground coverage in the lesion-side patch. Both patches receive negative logits ( − 6.166 -6.166 and − 8.052 -8.052 ), leaving the lesion-side patch undetected.
